similarity.feature: action-independent mean, standard deviation, maximum and legal-node count of the original candidate-node 24D observation
similarity.comparison_constraint: same checkpoint, load profile, current stage, and legal action mask

decision_rule: first residual flip at least 4 seconds after period start, otherwise first multi-legal decision
action_rule: prior argmax, full-Q argmax, residual argmax, full-Q argmin; first three distinct legal actions
